outline: 本課程主要介紹在計算機科學中常見或基本的資料結構,探討的主題包括: ADT(抽像資料型態)及複雜度, 靜態結構與儲存表示, 陣列，堆疊，佇列，串列，樹狀結構，遞迴，排序, 搜尋。
schedule:
Java Programming – Introduction (2 weeks)
Analysis Tools (1 week)
Arrays, Linked Lists, and Recursion (1 week)
Stacks (1 week)
Queues (1 week)
Skip Lists and Hashing (1 week)
Trees (2 week)
Priority Queues (2 weeks)
Maps and Dictionaries (2 weeks)
Search Trees (2 weeks)
Graphs (2 weeks)
assessment:
Assignments (40%)
Midterm (25%)
Final exam (35%)
The final grade might be adjusted.
